exposure: Moyamoya disease diagnosis timing (during vs. before pregnancy)
revascularization status (completed vs. not completed before pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 171 patients with Moyamoya disease who experienced 196 deliveries across four Korean tertiary institutions between 1990 and 2023.
finding: Not having completed revascularization before pregnancy or being hemodynamically unstable significantly increased the risk of peripartum cerebrovascular events in women with Moyamoya disease.
mod_finding: Delivery mode and anesthesia showed no significant association with the occurrence of cerebrovascular events.
